# Encryption and API Latency Standards Review

This document details the necessary actions regarding the bank's technical standards.

*   We need to monitor the encryption standards quarterly.
*   We need to review the API latency based on audit.
*   We need to review the API latency standard update.
*   We need to update the encryption standards for strategy 2026.
*   We need to monitor the encryption standards based on audit.
